text: 1275 introduces DeleteItem in the imported ews-rs API; that vendor landing is not itself a Thunderbird deletion implementation. At the fixed accepted endpoint, the owned delete_messages operation constructs hard-delete requests in chunks of 1000 and validates response count before pairing each response with its requested ID. The comment says the batch limit was learned from an error, not external documentation. This later code comparison does not cover a later chronological commit or validate the live service limit. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: The imported DeleteItem API is distinct from the later Thunderbird delete consumer
